image, forwards caller stdin, bounded program output, and any arguments after "--" as the
program's process arguments, preserves ordinary program status, and retains no artifact.
"fairyc test" checks the root package, one explicitly selected root-reachable local package, or every
unambiguous root-reachable local package with --workspace plus their isolated tests/ sources. It lists
canonical test identities or runs all, exact portable test directories, exact portable test files, or exact identities through the semantic interpreter or as
isolated Windows or Linux images with --native; --json selects a stable machine report for listing or execution,
--locations adds exact-current portable source anchors, and native tests receive any process arguments
after "--" in every isolated execution. Explicit --stdin attaches caller input only when exactly one
native test is selected; native tests otherwise receive EOF. Explicit --capture-output requires
native JSON execution and adds exact base64 process streams to each outcome.
Explicit --stdin-file replays one bounded workspace-contained file from byte zero to every native test.
Explicit --timeout-seconds bounds each isolated native test process and defaults to 60 seconds.
"fairyc experimental emit-workspace-c" writes one private, explicitly targeted C11 bootstrap unit
to stdout without invoking a toolchain. Its generated source is compiler-internal transport, not a
cross-release C API or standalone product artifact. Pass --release to build, run, or native test for
optimization. All four stable workspace commands read fairy.toml and refresh fairy.lock unless
--locked is supplied.
